mechanics.name: Eruption
mechanics.note: A Firesworn blows up when it dies; nobody should be next to one as it goes down.

mechanics.name: Massive Eruption
mechanics.note: The larger of the two Firesworn detonations, for the same reason and with the same answer: be somewhere else.

downtime.note: A Firesworn's death detonation window: melee are expected to step out, not to keep swinging. Same spell id as the Eruption mechanic above (verified 1.60.1.69893/spells.json#19497), read here as the detonation aura's own applied instant rather than as a damage hit.
